label: Source support for 144b0405 from I q.76 a.1 co.
note: The examples tie particular vital operations to a form, giving a case against a separation of a human being’s substantial form from its operations. The route needs the converse direction with unrestricted scope: every form in HasForm, including an intelligible form or an acquired form, must supply some attributed operation through that very form. A principle that enables an operation still needs an operation witness if OperatesThrough demands exercise.
